items: 【Sturdy 4-Leg Construction】 Unlike standard plant supports with three legs, our peony cages feature four heavy-duty support legs for enhanced stability. This robust 4-point design ensures the plant support cage stays firmly anchored when inserted into the soil, providing reliable resistance against strong winds and heavy rain for your valued outdoor plants

【Heavy-Duty Material & Finish】 Crafted from thick 4mm diameter iron wire, these peony cages and supports are built to last. The durable metal construction is coated with a weather-resistant finish to prevent rust and corrosion. This allows the peony support cage to be reused season after season, maintaining its strength to support tomatoes, hydrangeas, and flowers

【Optimal Size for Versatile Support】 With a 13-inch diameter and 24-inch height, this grow through plant support offers ample room for bushy growth. The ideal size provides crucial structural support for a wide variety of plants, helping peonies, cucumbers, and strawberries grow upright. It prevents stems from flopping or bending under the weight of blooms or fruit

【Simple Assembly & Space-Saving Storage】 These tomato cages for garden are designed for user-friendly assembly. Easily connect the legs to the ring to create a sturdy plant cage for outdoor plants in minutes. When the growing season ends, the peony supports can be quickly disassembled into flat components for compact storage, saving valuable space in your shed or garage

【Elegant Floral Design for Garden Aesthetics】 Featuring a unique flower-shaped grid top, this plant support cage provides effective encircling support while adding a decorative touch to your garden. The green coating blends seamlessly with foliage, creating a natural look. Ideal as plant cages for outdoor plants, it offers a functional and attractive support system for peonies, roses, and vegetables
